notes: Employees: full-time employees at December 31, 2025, from the 20-F's Item 6.D table (consolidated). Payroll: the IFRS note's total employee benefits expense for 2025 (NT$396,114.8 million: post-employment benefits 6,964.3, share-based payments 1,550.2 and other employee benefits 387,600.3, which include employee profit-sharing bonuses), recognized in cost of revenue (235,604.0) and operating expenses (160,510.8). TSMC is a foreign private issuer and has no CEO pay ratio.
